text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: We should prioritize conducting thorough manual testing of our links to identify any broken or missing connections. This decision allows us to quickly improve link coverage by addressing issues directly, yielding a significant increase in our metrics. The trade-off here is that this approach can be time-consuming and may delay other developments. However, the immediate benefits to link integrity justify the focus.

name: Scriv
text: I'm not convinced that manual testing is the most effective way to improve link coverage, as it can be time-consuming and prone to human error, potentially leading to inconsistent results. A better alternative might be to implement automated testing tools, which could provide more comprehensive and reliable coverage, albeit with an initial investment of time and resources to set up. To settle this argument, I'd like to see a cost-benefit analysis of both approaches, including the potential return on investment for automated testing tools.
